title: GTA6 Exclusion Zone: Alice in Wonderland Roguelite CRYMELIGHT Announced
description: Push Square previews the deep Alice in Wonderland roguelite CRYMELIGHT, launching on November 5 inside the GTA 6 exclusion zone.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Venturing Into the GTA 6 Exclusion Zone

As the gaming industry braces for the monumental launch of *GTA 6*, publishers and developers across the board are carefully mapping out their release schedules to avoid getting swallowed up by Rockstar's juggernaut. However, some independent titles are bravely or hilariously navigating right through what is colloquially known as the GTA 6 exclusion zone. According to a recent preview by gaming outlet Push Square, the upcoming *Alice in Wonderland*-themed roguelite *CRYMELIGHT* is one such title.

## Surprising Depth Behind the Wonderland Theme

Set to launch on 5th November, *CRYMELIGHT* embraces its whimsical inspirations with a "curiouser and curiouser" attitude. While many smaller projects scatter away from major blockbuster windows, this title is carving out its own space. Early impressions highlight that the game possesses a surprising amount of depth, making it much more than a simple thematic cash-grab and offering genuine roguelite mechanics that caught reviewers by surprise.

## Editor's Take

It is always amusing to see smaller independent titles willingly launch inside the shadow of massive industry events or blockbusters like *GTA 6*. Whether *CRYMELIGHT* can carve out a loyal audience on 5th November remains to be seen, but its sheer audacity to challenge the exclusion zone deserves a nod of respect.
